sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER

This is first application for grant of anticipatory bail under section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973 on behalf of the applicant who is apprehending her arrest in connection with Crime No.404/2022 dated 13.08.2022 registered at Police Station Amiliya, district Sidhi, for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467 and 120-B of IPC.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and h a s been falsely implicated in the crime in question.
The applicant is a permanent resident of district Sidhi and there is no likelihood of her absconding or tampering with prosecution evidence.
The applicant is willing and ready to abide by all the directions and conditions to be imposed by this Court.
Learned counsel for the applicant also submits that the trial would take considerable time.
Therefore, prayer has been made to enlarge the applicant on anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
The applicant has prayed for grant of anticipatory bail.

Her earlier application was dismissed as withdrawn by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 13.3.2023 passed in M.Cr.C. No.7323/2023 in the light of statements made by learned counsel for the State that a notice will be issued to the applicant under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C.
According to the applicant, that notice has not been issued till date.
The facts of the case reveal that the applicant was a kiosk operator from which the family pension of complainant was fraudulently withdrawn to the tune of Rs.14,000/-.

The charge-sheet against rest of the accused persons has already been filed and the police report does not suggest that any investigation is to be conducted in the case with regard to the present applicant.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and the finding that there is no requirement of custodial interrogation of the applicant, this Court deems it appropriate to release the applicant on anticipatory bail.
Hence, the application is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest of applicant by the police in the aforesaid crime, he shall be released on anticipatory bail on her furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer) for her regular appearance before the Police/Arresting Officer during the investigation or before the Court during trial.

It is directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 438(2) of Cr.P.C., failing which this order shall automatically stand cancelled without further reference to the Court.

Accordingly, the M.Cr.C stands allowed and disposed of.
(ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE ps Date: 2023.08.18 18:11:31 +05'30'
